[LSIG.2.3.3] At query time $t$ the runtime must compute `integral` from the
state of [LSIG.2.3.1] read-only, as [LSIG.2.2.3] does `active_fraction`:

$\mathit{integral}(t) = \Big(S - \sum_{i\,:\,t_i \le t-W} x_i\,\big(\min(t_{i+1},\ t-W) - t_i\big)\Big) + x_{\mathrm{open}}\,\big(t - \max(t_{\mathrm{open}},\ t-W)\big)$

with $t_{i+1}$ as [LSIG.2.3.1] defines it. The value is evaluated in the order
written ([LSIG.4.1]): the sum accumulated oldest entry first, subtracted from
$S$, then the open interval's term added, clipped to the window and held to $t$.

Query cost is O(K), the bounded-staleness property shared with
`SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` ([LSIG.2.2.5]).
